## Proposed change
<!-- 
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
This pull request fixes a very popular problem that would cause the Panasonic Viera integration to set the `media_player` entity to `"on"` even if it was turned off on models that stay connected when in standby. Now, the state is retrieved by subscribing to UPnP services (`dmr/event_0` and `nrc/event_0`) that receive info through an HTTP server to which the TV sends updates. These updates are parsed and stored in local variables.

Because of this new method of getting information about the TV, we're now also able to display the title of the open app, for example. However, it's all very provisory, and will be more precise when source selection is implemented in the future.


## Type of change
<!--
  What type of change does your PR introduce to Home Assistant?
  NOTE: Please, check only 1! box! 
  If your PR requires multiple boxes to be checked, you'll most likely need to

## Example entry for `configuration.yaml`:

-->
There's now a `listen_port` option that allows the user to define the server in which the HTTP server will be initialised. The default is just `55000`, the same port of the TV 🤷‍♂️
